info.title: Get Global Product
info.description: Retrieve all properties of a global product that is in the "DRAFT", "UNPUBLISHED", or "PUBLISHED" status, and the corresponding local product IDs in the published markets.

get.description: Retrieve all properties of a global product that is in the "DRAFT", "UNPUBLISHED", or "PUBLISHED" status, and the corresponding local product IDs in the published markets.

parameters.name: x-tts-access-token
parameters.description: The seller access_token value from [Get Access Token](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/678e3a3292b0f40314a92d75#Get%20Access%20Token%20API), when user_type = 0. Follow this [guide](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/678e3a344ddec3030b238fa0) to get seller access_token.

parameters.name: app_key
parameters.description: Every single app will have a unique key. Please use the specific key assigned to your app.

parameters.name: sign
parameters.description: Signature generated by gen algorithm. When you send API requests to TTS, you must sign them so that TTS can identify the senders.

parameters.name: timestamp
parameters.description: Unix timestamp GMT (UTC+00:00). This timestamp is used across all API requests. Developers can use this convert to local time.

name.description: The name of the certification file

format.description: The format of the certification file.

images.description: A list of certification related images.

id.description: The global SKU ID in TikTok Shop.

seller_sku.description: An internal code/name for managing SKUs, not visible to buyers.

currency.description:
The currency.
Possible values:
- `USD`: Applicable for global sellers
- `EUR`: Applicable for intra-EU sellers

unit_price.description:
The unit price of the SKU. 
You can display the unit price to facilitate easier price comparisons across different products and packaging sizes.
Applicable only for the EU market.

**Note**: 
- This value is available only if you have defined the elements used to calculate this price when creating the product.
- Unit price = Selling price/(SKU unit count/base unit count)

price.description:
The SKU's **global uniform pre-tax** price that serves as the baseline for calculating the local prices across different markets.

**Note**: 
- Upon publishing, this price will be automatically converted to the local pre-tax price and local display price based on market-specific exchange rates and applicable charges such as shipping costs, taxes, and other fees.
- The auto-conversion will exclude JP and US shops using China warehouses.

global_quantity.description:
The total SKU inventory quantity across all shops globally. 

The inventory for each local shop is automatically calculated when a product is first published. After publishing, this global quantity cannot be manually changed. You can only modify the inventory quantity in each local shop.

type.description:
The type of identifier code.
Possible values:
- GTIN
- EAN
- UPC
- ISBN
- JAN

identifier_code.description: A regulated identifier code assigned to a product based on international standardized regulations (e.g. GTIN) to ensure the product is universally identifiable across various platforms and systems.

thumb_urls.description: The URLs to view the image thumbnails.

urls.description: The URLs to view the images.

sku_img.description: An image to display for the SKU.

sales_attributes.description: A list of attributes  (e.g. size, color, length) that define each variant of a product.

global_warehouse_id.description: The ID of the global warehouse where the SKU is stored.

quantity.description: The SKU quantity available in the warehouse.

sku_unit_count.description:
The total quantity/volume of the product represented by the SKU.
For example, if the SKU represents 500ml of water, this value would be 500 if the unit type is defined as ml.
Applicable only for the EU market.

**Note**: 
- This is mainly used to calculate the unit price of the SKU, and is required only if you wish to display the unit price to facilitate easier price comparisons across different products and packaging sizes.
- Unit price = Selling price/(SKU unit count/base unit count). Therefore if you want to obtain the unit price, you would also need to define the "base unit count" and the "unit type" product attributes. Retrieve the relevant information for these product attributes by using the [Get Global Attributes API](650a0483c16ffe02b8dfc80a).

extra_identifier_codes.description:
A list of up to 10 additional identifier codes if the SKU belongs to a virtual bundle (containing multiple individual SKUs).

**Note**: Applicable only for the EU market.

external_global_sku_id.description: An external identifier used in an external ecommerce platform. This is used to associate the SKU between TikTok Shop and the external ecommerce platform.

skus.description: A list of global Stock Keeping Units (SKUs) used to identify distinct variants of the product.

update_time.description:
The time when the product is last updated.
Unix timestamp.

create_time.description:
The time when the product is created.
Unix timestamp.

id.description: The ID of the product attribute.

values.description: A list of selectable values for the product attribute.

product_attributes.description: A list of general attributes (e.g. manufacturer, country of origin, materials used) that describe the product as a whole, regardless of variant.

image.description: An image of the size chart.

template.description: A TikTok Shop size chart template generated by the size chart tool in Seller Center > Manage Products > Bulk action > Batch manage size charts.

size_chart.description: The measurement details of the product to help buyers find the right size.

region.description: The market where the local product is listed.

global_sku_id.description: The global SKU ID in TikTok Shop.

local_sku_id.description: The local SKU ID in TikTok Shop.

global_value_id.description: The global sales attribute value ID.

local_value_id.description: The local sales attribute value ID.

sales_attribute_mappings.description: The list of sales attribute mappings between the global and local SKUs.

sku_mappings.description: The list of sku mappings between the global and local products.

products.description: The local products associated through global product publishing or manual binding.

id.description: The ID of the brand of this product.

phone_number.description: The phone number of the manufacturer.

email.description: The email address of the manufacturer.

manufacturer.description:
(**Deprecated**: This field is deprecated and will be removed in a future API version. Use `manufacturer_ids` instead.)

The product manufacturer's details.
If there are more than one manufacturer information, only the first-added manufacturer will be returned in this field.

responsible_person_ids.description:
A comma-delimited list of responsible person IDs. Retrieve the IDs from the [Search Responsible Persons API](67066a55f17b7d02f95d2fb1).
**Note**: Applicable only for the EU market in certain categories.

manufacturer_ids.description:
A comma-delimited list of manufacturer IDs. Retrieve the IDs from the [Search Manufacturers API](67066a580dcee902fa03ccf9).
**Note**: Applicable only for the EU market in certain categories.
